exercises.prompt: Select the correct verb form when the verb precedes an overt plural subject: 'The students wrote the lesson.'
exercises.explanation: In V-S-O order, a verb preceding an overt masculine plural subject remains masculine singular: كَتَبَ الطُّلَّابُ.

feedback.rule: When a verb precedes an explicit plural noun subject, it remains singular and agrees only in gender.
feedback.commonError: Using plural كَتَبُوا before an explicit plural subject.

exercises.prompt: Match each conjugated past-tense form of كَتَبَ to its person.
exercises.explanation: Past-tense subject pronouns attach as suffixes to the triliteral stem.

feedback.rule: Form I past tense suffix paradigm

exercises.prompt: Arrange the words into a classical V-S-O sentence: 'The students wrote the lesson.'
exercises.explanation: Classical verbal sentences place the verb first (كَتَبَ), then the nominative fāʿil (الطُّلَّابُ), then the accusative mafʿūl bihi (الدَّرْسَ).

feedback.rule: V-S-O word order: Fiʿl + Fāʿil (marfūʿ) + Mafʿūl Bihi (manṣūb).
